docs.title: CryptokiMan ( PKCS#11 Cryptoki Manager )
docs.text:
This program is a PKCS#11 module Cryptoki library management program.

The file can be downloaded from this page link (size is about 30M) Actually, the module test was done with the library downloaded from https://www.opendnssec.org/softhsm/. This is a program I made personally, so if you have any questions or bugs, use Google Groups

docs.title: CryptokiMan Main Window Guide
docs.text: This guide explains the CryptokiMan main window and its menus. It is based on the window layout and behavior defined in mainwindow.cpp, mainwindow.h, and mainwindow.ui.

docs.title: Main window at a glance
docs.text:
The main window is organized into three working areas:

  1. Navigation tree (left): After a Cryptoki library is loaded, use this tree to browse its Cryptoki module, slots, tokens, mechanisms, sessions, and objects. Select a node to show its details or contents in the table.
  2. Details and object table (right): Displays the fields and values for the selected tree item, or a list of objects. The table is read-only; select a row to inspect it, and double-click a row to open its detailed view. Right-click an object row for actions available for that object type.
  3. Information and Log dock (bottom): The Information tab shows details for the current selection. The Log tab shows application and operation messages. The dock can be shown from File > Show log tab.

The navigation tree and table are separated by a horizontal splitter, so you can resize their relative widths. The bottom dock can be resized or hidden using the normal Qt dock controls. The status bar displays short status messages such as Ready.

docs.title: Getting started
docs.text:
1. Choose File > Open... and select a PKCS #11 Cryptoki library provided by your token or HSM vendor. You can also drag a library file into the main window.
  2. Expand the tree and select a slot or token to review its information. Select Mechanisms to inspect supported cryptographic mechanisms, or open a session to work with token objects.
  3. Use Module > Open Session to open a session on the selected token. Authenticate with Module > Login when an operation requires an authenticated user.
  4. Select an object category or object in the tree to display its entries in the right-hand table. Use the Objects, Cryptography, Import, and Tools menus to perform supported operations.
  5. Review operation results and errors in the Information and Log tabs.

Only one Cryptoki library can be loaded at a time. Use File > Unload before opening a different library. Available actions depend on the selected token, module capabilities, object permissions, and license status.

docs.title: File
docs.text: Command Description New Opens another CryptokiMan window. Open... Selects and loads a PKCS #11 Cryptoki library. Unload Unloads the currently loaded library. Show log tab Shows the bottom Information and Log dock. Recent Files Reopens a recently loaded Cryptoki library. Up to ten recent entries are kept. Quit Exits CryptokiMan.

docs.title: View
docs.text: The View menu controls which buttons appear on the toolbars. Its submenus group checkable actions under File ToolBar, Module ToolBar, Object ToolBar, Cryptogram ToolBar, Import ToolBar, Tools ToolBar, and Help ToolBar. Checking a command displays its button on the corresponding toolbar; clearing it hides the button. The command remains available from its main menu. This menu is created when the application has a valid license.

docs.title: Module
docs.text: Command Description Initialize Initializes the Cryptoki module (C_Initialize). Finalize Finalizes the module (C_Finalize) and releases its state. Open Session Opens a session on the selected token (C_OpenSession). Close Session Closes the selected session (C_CloseSession). Close All Sessions Closes all sessions for the selected token (C_CloseAllSessions). Login Authenticates to the token in the selected session (C_Login). Logout Ends the authenticated state for the selected session (C_Logout).

docs.title: Objects
docs.text: Command Description Generate Key Pair Generates a public/private key pair on the token (C_GenerateKeyPair). Generate Key Generates a secret key on the token (C_GenerateKey). Create Data Creates a data object using the supplied attributes. Create RSA Public Key / Create RSA Private Key Creates an RSA key object using supplied key attributes. Create ECDSA Public Key / Create ECDSA Private Key Creates an elliptic-curve key object, commonly used for ECDSA. Create EDDSA Public Key / Create EDDSA Private Key Creates an Edwards-curve digital-signature key object. Create DSA Public Key / Create DSA Private Key Creates a DSA key object using supplied key attributes. Create PQC Public Key / Create PQC Private Key Creates a post-quantum cryptography key object supported by the module. Create Key Creates a key object from a user-specified template. Destroy Object Deletes the selected object from the token (C_DestroyObject). Edit Object Edits attributes of the selected object, subject to token permissions. Edit Attribute List Edits a list of attributes for an object. Copy Object Creates a copy of the selected object, optionally using changed attributes (C_CopyObject). Find Objects Searches the selected session for objects matching specified attributes.

docs.title: Cryptography
docs.text: Command Description Random Generates random bytes using the token (C_GenerateRandom). Digest Computes a message digest with a mechanism supported by the module. Signature Signs data using a selected private key and signature mechanism. Verify Verifies a signature against data using a selected public key and mechanism. Encrypt Encrypts data using a selected key and supported mechanism. Decrypt Decrypts data using a selected key and supported mechanism. HSM Manage Opens the HSM management interface for supported device operations.

docs.title: Import
docs.text: Command Description Import certificate Imports a certificate and creates a certificate object on the token. Import PFX Imports a PKCS #12/PFX bundle, which can contain certificates and a private key. Import Private Key Imports a supported private-key file and creates a key object on the token.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: Command Description Initialize Token Initializes a token (C_InitToken), setting its label and security-officer PIN. Token initialization can erase existing contents. Operation State Reads or restores the state of an ongoing cryptographic operation when supported. Set PIN Changes a token user's PIN (C_SetPIN). Init PIN Initializes the user PIN, typically after a security-officer login (C_InitPIN). Wrap Key Exports a key in wrapped (encrypted) form using a wrapping key and supported mechanism. Unwrap Key Imports a wrapped key and creates a key object using an unwrapping key and template. Derive Key Derives a new key from a base key using a supported mechanism. Type Name Opens the type-name utility for PKCS #11 type information. Make CSR Creates a certificate signing request using a selected key and request fields. CAVP Opens the Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program utility for supported validation operations.

docs.title: Help
docs.text: Command Description Clear Log Clears the messages displayed in the Log tab. Log Toggles log output on or off. Settings Opens CryptokiMan application settings. License Information Displays license details and status. Bug or Issue Report Opens the project issue-reporting destination. Q and A Opens the project's question-and-answer or discussion destination. About CryptokiMan Displays application information.

docs.title: Object context menu
docs.text:
Right-click an object row in the table to see commands for its type. The available set differs for certificates, public keys, private keys, secret keys, and data objects.

Command Description View Object Displays the selected object's attributes and details. Edit Attribute / Edit AttributeList Edits one attribute or the object's attribute list. Delete Object Destroys the selected token object. View Certificate Displays certificate information. Export Certficate Exports the selected certificate. Verify / Encrypt Uses the selected public key in a signature-verification or encryption operation. Export PublicKey / View PublicKey Exports or displays the selected public key. Sign / Decrypt Uses the selected private key in a signing or decryption operation. Export PrivateKey / View PrivateKey Exports or displays the selected private key, if permitted. Make CSR Creates a CSR using the selected private key. Copy Object Copies the selected object.

Secret-key rows may offer Sign, Verify, Encrypt, and Decrypt. Data-object rows offer Copy Object in addition to the general object actions. Context actions may be disabled when the active license does not allow them.

docs.title: Reading the details table
docs.text: Information tables use Field and Value columns for general properties. Depending on the selected tree item, the table can show Cryptoki library details, slot or token properties, supported mechanisms, session state, object attributes, certificate fields, or key information. Selecting a listed mechanism or object may show additional details in the Information tab or an object-specific view.

docs.title: Source files
docs.text:
• mainwindow.ui defines the base Qt main-window shell: menu bar, initial toolbar, central widget, and status bar.
  • mainwindow.cpp creates the runtime menus and toolbars, builds the tree/table and bottom dock, loads libraries, and implements the table context menu.
  • mainwindow.h declares the main-window interface, slots, view controls, data views, and UI state.

docs.title: CryptokiMan Menu Guide
docs.text: This guide describes the menus and context-menu commands created by mainwindow.cpp and its menu helper. CryptokiMan is a graphical manager for PKCS #11 (Cryptoki) libraries, tokens, sessions, and cryptographic objects. Some commands may be disabled or hidden depending on the active license and settings.

docs.title: File
docs.text: Command Description New Opens another CryptokiMan window. Open... Selects and loads a PKCS #11 Cryptoki library. The library provides access to the cryptographic token or HSM. Unload Unloads the currently loaded Cryptoki library. Show log tab Shows the information and log dock at the bottom of the window. Recent Files Reopens one of the recently loaded Cryptoki libraries. Quit Exits CryptokiMan.

docs.title: View
docs.text: The View menu configures which actions appear on each toolbar. Its submenus are File ToolBar, Module ToolBar, Object ToolBar, Cryptogram ToolBar, Import ToolBar, Tools ToolBar, and Help ToolBar. Each submenu contains checkable items corresponding to the commands in the matching menu; checking an item shows that command on the toolbar, and unchecking it hides the toolbar button. The command remains available from its main menu.

docs.title: Module
docs.text:
These commands operate on the loaded PKCS #11 module, its slots, and sessions.

Command Description Initialize Initializes the Cryptoki module (C_Initialize) before using its services. Finalize Finalizes the Cryptoki module (C_Finalize) and releases module state. Open Session Opens a session on the selected token (C_OpenSession). Close Session Closes the selected session (C_CloseSession). Close All Sessions Closes all sessions for the selected token (C_CloseAllSessions). Login Authenticates to the token in the selected session (C_Login), typically as a user or security officer. Logout Ends the current authenticated state for the selected session (C_Logout).

docs.title: Objects
docs.text:
Create, inspect, find, copy, edit, or destroy objects in the selected session. Availability depends on token support and object permissions.

Command Description Generate Key Pair Generates a public/private key pair on the token (C_GenerateKeyPair). Generate Key Generates a secret key on the token (C_GenerateKey). Create Data Creates a data object with the supplied attributes (C_CreateObject). Create RSA Public Key Creates an RSA public-key object from the supplied key attributes. Create RSA Private Key Creates an RSA private-key object from the supplied key attributes. Create ECDSA Public Key Creates an elliptic-curve public-key object (commonly used for ECDSA). Create ECDSA Private Key Creates an elliptic-curve private-key object (commonly used for ECDSA). Create EDDSA Public Key Creates an Edwards-curve digital-signature public-key object. Create EDDSA Private Key Creates an Edwards-curve digital-signature private-key object. Create DSA Public Key Creates a DSA public-key object from the supplied key attributes. Create DSA Private Key Creates a DSA private-key object from the supplied key attributes. Create PQC Public Key Creates a post-quantum cryptography public-key object supported by the module. Create PQC Private Key Creates a post-quantum cryptography private-key object supported by the module. Create Key Creates a key object from explicitly supplied attributes (C_CreateObject-style creation). Destroy Object Deletes the selected token object (C_DestroyObject). Edit Object Edits attributes of a selected object. Only attributes permitted by the token can be changed. Edit Attribute List Edits an object's attribute list in a batch-oriented editor. Copy Object Creates a copy of a selected object, optionally with changed attributes (C_CopyObject). Find Objects Searches the selected session for objects matching the specified attributes.

docs.title: Cryptography
docs.text:
Run cryptographic operations through the loaded module and selected session or key.

Command Description Random Requests random bytes from the token's random-number generator (C_GenerateRandom). Digest Computes a message digest using a mechanism supported by the module. Signature Signs data with a selected private key and signature mechanism. Verify Verifies a signature against data using a selected public key and mechanism. Encrypt Encrypts data using a selected key and encryption mechanism. Decrypt Decrypts data using a selected key and decryption mechanism. HSM Manage Opens the HSM management interface for supported device-management operations.

docs.title: Import
docs.text: Command Description Import certificate Imports a certificate and creates a certificate object on the token. Import PFX Imports a PKCS #12/PFX bundle, which may contain a certificate chain and private key, subject to token support and bundle contents. Import Private Key Imports a private key from a supported key file and creates a key object on the token.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: Command Description Initialize Token Initializes a token (C_InitToken), setting its label and security-officer PIN. Initialization may erase existing token contents. Operation State Gets or sets the saved state of an ongoing cryptographic operation when supported by the module. Set PIN Changes the user or security-officer PIN for the selected token (C_SetPIN). Init PIN Initializes the user PIN, typically after the security officer has logged in (C_InitPIN). Wrap Key Exports a key in wrapped (encrypted) form using a wrapping key and supported mechanism. Unwrap Key Imports a wrapped key and creates a key object using an unwrapping key and template. Derive Key Derives a new key from a base key and mechanism supported by the token. Type Name Displays or selects PKCS #11 type-name information used by the application. Make CSR Creates a certificate signing request (CSR), using a selected key and certificate-request fields. CAVP Opens the Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program (CAVP) utility for supported validation vectors or operations.

docs.title: Help
docs.text: Command Description Clear Log Clears the messages shown in the log tab. Log Toggles log collection; the status tip describes the action as halting the log. Settings Opens CryptokiMan application settings. License Information Shows license details and status. Bug or Issue Report Opens the project's bug or issue reporting destination. Q and A Opens the project's question-and-answer or discussion destination. About CryptokiMan Shows application and version information.

docs.title: Object context menu
docs.text:
Right-clicking an object row in the object table shows commands appropriate to that object's type. The exact set differs for certificates, public keys, private keys, secret keys, and other objects.

Command Description View Object Displays the selected object's attributes and details. Edit Attribute Edits an attribute of the selected object. Edit AttributeList Opens the attribute-list editor for the selected object. Delete Object Destroys the selected object on the token. View Certificate Displays certificate information. Copy Object Copies the selected object. Export Certficate Exports the selected certificate. Verify Verifies a signature using the selected public key. Encrypt Encrypts data using the selected public key. Export PublicKey Exports the selected public key. View PublicKey Displays public-key information. Sign Signs data using the selected private key. Decrypt Decrypts data using the selected private key. Export PrivateKey Exports the selected private key when permitted. View PrivateKey Displays private-key information and available attributes. Make CSR Creates a CSR using the selected private key.

The object table may also offer Verify, Encrypt, Sign, or Decrypt for secret-key objects when the relevant operation is supported.
